Gofen & Glossberg Llc decreased its stake in Procter & Gamble (PG) by 1.56% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Gofen & Glossberg Llc sold 12,448 shares as the company’s stock declined 15.56% with the market. The institutional investor held 785,630 shares of the package goods and cosmetics company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $72.18 million, down from 798,078 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Gofen & Glossberg Llc who had been investing in Procter & Gamble for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $186.23B market cap company. The stock increased 0.83% or $0.61 during the last trading session, reaching $74.06. About 6.43M shares traded. The Procter & Gamble Company (NYSE:PG) has declined 14.03% since May 22, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 25.58% the S&P500.
Savant Capital Llc decreased its stake in Marriott Intl Inc New (MAR) by 0.87% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 254,864 shares of the hotels and resorts company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $34.51 million, down from 257,090 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Savant Capital Llc who had been investing in Marriott Intl Inc New for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $49.05B market cap company. The stock increased 0.20% or $0.28 during the last trading session, reaching $138.8. About 901,621 shares traded. Marriott International, Inc. (NASDAQ:MAR) has risen 45.53% since May 22, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 33.98% the S&P500.
Analysts await The Procter & Gamble Company (NYSE:PG) to report earnings on July, 26. They expect $0.91 earnings per share, up 7.06% or $0.06 from last year’s $0.85 per share. PG’s profit will be $2.29 billion for 20.35 P/E if the $0.91 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.00 actual earnings per share reported by The Procter & Gamble Company for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -9.00% negative EPS growth.
